notes: C1: resolved Reynolds-shear share is 1.24e-06 (limit 0.50); v_rms^2 max is 5.60e-05 u_tau^2, so the perturbation field left after the transient is numerical noise.
C2: momentum-balance residual is 0.708 u_tau^2 (limit 0.05); it is 86.7% of the mean imposed shear in the window.

C3: the averaging window spans 3.61 flow-through times (limit 1.0), i.e. 1.51 h/u_tau = 271 wall-time units, against a viscous relaxation time h^2/nu = 180 h/u_tau; the criterion passes and is not what condemns the run.
The graded profile sits 0.14 u+ (1.0%) away from the run's own initial condition inside the window, i.e. it never evolved by more than the deviation it is graded on.
Bookkeeping: dt+ is 0.222, not the 40.0 printed in the shipped report (that value used Re_tau**2 instead of Re_tau); the flow-through count (3.61) is unchanged.
